notes.title: Japanese Language Update
notes.notes:
A note for those of you who may be wondering why they are experiencing an update for The Awesome Adventures of Captain Spirit, and great news for those with a knowledge or interest in the Japanese language...

A Japanese audio and subtitle update is now available to all players!
